catch-phrase: Art of fighting, fighting for art
intro: AH2R is a personal tribute to an exceptional person, the kind you only meet once in a lifetime, who sadly left us in June 2006. Mireille Caire taught us everything and made us realize that the greatest fighters are not necessarily those we encounter in rings or on tatami mats, but rather those in hospital beds who choose to fight to the very end against illness and death... All those who had the great privilege of knowing this petite woman with an angelic smile and infinite kindness will always have a fond memory of her.
